comparison.objective: Assemble a split spacer around a captive shaft; candidate fractures and recovers four insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: From the title, coordinating spacer halves around a constrained shaft versus aligning and stabilizing a narrow mandrel, hammering, and retrieving free fragments.
comparison.success_condition: Available evidence reports a full-score demo but omits the spacer's engagement thresholds; candidate requires four contact-loaded fractures, all fragments deposited, and no damage.
comparison.reason: Captive-shaft spacer assembly is a meaningfully different central outcome and mechanism from notch fracture and debris recovery, despite incomplete numeric rubric evidence.
